events.event: Khafre reign in Egyptian Ministry chronology; construction program of second Giza pyramid complex.
Great Sphinx carved from bedrock; official and AERA archaeological interpretations strongly associate its final construction sequence with Khafre.
Thutmose IV erected the Dream Stela between the Sphinx paws; later royal cult/restoration context.
Belzoni discovered the entrance/passages leading to Khafre burial chamber; date independently preserved in museum/historical records.
Vyse/Perring team cleared/re-entered and documented passages/chambers, with survey plates later published by Perring.
Perring Vol. II published survey/admeasurement of Second and Third Pyramids.
Petrie undertook high-precision Giza survey that remains a primary metric backbone.
Petrie published The Pyramids and Temples of Gizeh.
Digital Giza preserves excavation diary context for Khafre Valley Temple; Hölscher-era complex excavation documentation continues in early 20th century.
ARCE Sphinx Project produced the first detailed scale plans/elevations, geological/topographic mapping and photogrammetric archive of the Sphinx complex.
Memphis and its Necropolis including Giza pyramid fields inscribed as UNESCO World Heritage property 86.
Nell and Ruggles conducted Total Station survey of Giza pyramid/associated-structure orientations.
Khafre facade photographic condition campaign documented fractures/cracks, with major features checked in situ in 2012.
AERA reports renewed Sphinx documentation using mapping/topographic survey/GPR, with Japanese drone, photogrammetry and laser-scanning work.
Kawae published overview of drone 3-D survey at Giza.
ScIDEP Khafre muography project paper published in Journal of Applied Physics.
AERA bibliography records First Laser Survey of the Second Great Pyramid. Underlying data remain an acquisition target.
